svg.text: POST-COMBUSTION AMINE PACKED ABSORBER & THERMAL STRIPPER SYSTEM
Point-Source Flue Gas Chemical Absorption & Steam Solvent Regeneration (ISO 10628 / NETL Rev 4a B12B.90)
BASIS: 1,000 kg CAPTURED CO2 (CANSOLV / 30 wt% MEA)
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: PROCESS MASS & THERMAL ENERGY BALANCE (NETL B12B.90)
Shell CANSOLV DC-103 / 30 wt% MEA aqueous solution
2.45 GJ_th / t CO2 (LP steam @ 3.0 bar extracted from turbine)
111.0 kWh_e / t CO2 (Fans: 30.9 kWh | Compression: 80.1 kWh)
DCC quenches from 58 °C to 40 °C; NaOH polish limits SO2 < 0.37 ppmv
90.0% capture efficiency | Amine aerosol loss < 0.5 kg / t CO2
CO2 + 2 RNH2 <=> RNHCOO- + RNH3+ (ΔH = -84.5 kJ/mol CO2)
RNHCOO- + RNH3+ + Steam => CO2(g) + 2 RNH2 (Lean Loading α=0.20)
AUDIT METRICS: Capture: 90% | Reboiler Duty: 2.45 GJ_th / t | Elec: 111 kWh_e / t
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: NETL Rev 4a (2022); Rochelle (2009) Science
